retrieval_policy.title: Iterative retrieval
retrieval_policy.when: Answering questions with the document tools
action_sequence: search → read → evaluate → entity_hop when a concrete entity in visible evidence may lead to missing information → read → answer

retrieval_policy.title: Multi-hop questions
action_sequence: Decompose the problem and tackle each sub-question step by step

retrieval_policy.title: Evidence-conditioned entity hopping
retrieval_policy.when: Visible evidence contains a concrete entity and related information is still missing
action_sequence: Use that entity with entity_hop to find related chunks, then read useful returned chunks
